description.en-US: The Sinner's Guide in the English of a Dominican Father (C. H. McKenna OP, 1883): both books of Granada's Guía de pecadores in 48 chapters, from the TAN reprint.
description.pt-BR: A Guia de pecadores na tradução inglesa de um padre dominicano (C. H. McKenna OP, 1883), em 48 capítulos.

en-US.translator: C. H. McKenna OP ("a Dominican Father")

sources.edition: The Sinner's Guide, translated from the Spanish by a Dominican Father [C. H. McKenna OP] (London 1883); archive.org scan of the TAN Books reprint, OCR text.
sources.description: All 48 chapters of the 1883 translation, which divides the work differently from the Spanish (48 chapters against 29 + 23). The TAN introduction, the papal brief and the publisher's pages are removed. Section headings are kept. The last page's OCR is damaged at the line starts and was repaired by hand.
